_doc: REACH-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-17): promotion and outreach run themselves; the owner supplies ideas only. Events the system already records become posts, feeds and pings; reach is measured from first-party hits; the weights of what is posted move toward what readers actually act on. Read by foundation/reach.py (python3 -m foundation reach --check|--run [--apply]). Twin of QNFO qnfo-social (Thompson-style learner, per-channel caps, engagement over volume).

consent.source: project thread 'Make promotion and outreach autonomous'
consent.scope: owned-channel publishing (own site feeds, search pings, own social accounts) leaves dry-run; cold outreach to individuals is never in scope

shipped.what: a change the system shipped, from the public changelog

proof.what: a check the live system passes, from its own records

systems.what: what kind of system it runs and what it is not for

evergreen.text: Practical Solutions is a public-benefit demo: small teams get routine work (intake, scheduling, newsletters) handled by an autonomous system.
Ultrastable is for systems that keep running and keep needing work. It is not for one-off pages or weekend apps.
Every claim on ultrastable.io is re-checked against the system's own records, and the checks are public.

targets.what: outside-referred human page views in 7 days
views referred from social hosts in 7 days
views referred from search engines in 7 days
human views of Practical Solutions pages in 7 days
posts actually published to owned channels in 7 days
